title: Part Library entries from before the release stay listed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · access to the test environment before the Part Lifecycle build is deployed (for Setup step 1) · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], Admin role.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: [Old-E], a Part Library entry that existed before the deployment with nothing behind it ("Total parts" 0), and [Old-F], an entry that existed before with a part behind it. This case only reads them.

Setup

  1. Before the Part Lifecycle build is deployed, sign in on the earlier build as [User-A], pick [Loc-1], and create with Parts → Catalog → New Catalog Part an entry such as ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDENTRY-01 (never stock it), and a second, ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDENTRY-02, which you then stock with Parts → Inventory → New Inventory Part.
  2. If the build was deployed before step 1 could be done, pick instead, on the Part Lifecycle build, one existing entry whose detail page shows "Total parts" 0 and one whose detail page shows "Total parts" 1 or more, both created before the deployment (this case does not change them).
  3. [Old-E] = the entry with nothing behind it; [Old-F] = the entry with a part behind it.
  4. Check the setup worked: you have both part numbers written down.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in on the Part Lifecycle build as [User-A].
  2. Pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  3. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  4. Type [Old-E] in the Search box.
  5. Click the [Old-E] row.
  6. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  7. Type [Old-F] in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: [Old-E] is still listed although nothing uses it.
  • Step 5: Its detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 0: it was neither deleted nor hidden by the release.
  • Step 7: [Old-F] is still listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S11-E1, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E1: “Part Library entries that exist on the day of release stay in the list, including the ones nothing references. This spec does not delete or hide them.”
